notes: Added missing schema/contract, API exposure, formatting, and test coverage stories for FEAT-3.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure strict contract validation.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Extract, normalize, and structure trial location data from ClinicalTrials.gov responses, including handling multiple sites per trial and ensuring consistent geographic formatting for downstream distance calculations.

stories.title: API Endpoint Exposure via Tool Router
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search capability through the tool router with allowlisted tool definition, ensuring validated inputs, safe execution, and compatibility with the agentic tool-use loop.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Result Formatting for Chat Output
stories.description: Format clinical trial search results into structured, user-readable responses including trial title, status, locations, and travel metrics, optimized for conversational delivery.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Implement unit tests for query construction, location extraction, and distance computation, plus integration tests covering end-to-end clinical trials search through the facade and tool router.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found; must create new tests aligned with existing backend test patterns in Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/
